payload.title: Remove the developer home path shipped to the browser in the steering workspace
payload.description:
components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx:13610 hard-codes cwd: "/Users/ryan/Projects/Biblicus" inside analysisCommand() in a "use client" file, so a developer's home path ships to every browser and the generated analysis plan is wrong on every other machine. Also fix the three /Users/ryan/Projects/Papyrus/... links in skills/newsroom-story-cycle/SKILL.md and skills/edition-planning/SKILL.md (make them repo-relative) and replace --corpus-key AI-ML-research in their smoke commands with a <corpus-key> placeholder.

Fix: move the executable and cwd into the analysis-profile config (corpora/papyrus-analysis-profiles.yml) or resolve them in the Lambda that runs the plan; the UI emits only args.

Done when: grep -rn '/Users/' components lib app skills returns nothing.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
